title: Member's liability to third parties.
bodyText: A member of a corporation is not, as such, personally liable for the acts, debts, liabilities, or obligations of the corporation.
bodyHtml: [§414D-85]  Member's liability to third parties.  A member of a corporation is not, as such, personally liable for the acts, debts, liabilities, or obligations of the corporation. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]
